safe_vamd.dimensionless_quantities.wave_number_with_absorption module¶

class safe_vamd.dimensionless_quantities.wave_number_with_absorption.WaveNumberWithAbsorption(source: Source, backfield: BackgroundField, c: MathFunc)¶

Bases: MathFunc

The wave number with an added imaginary term to account for air absorption, implemented as subclass of MathFunc: The air absorption is computed with the methodology in https://doi.org/10.1121/1.412989.

source¶

An instance of the Source class with monopole source information.

Type:

Source

backfield:BackgroundField

An instance of the BackgroundField class representing the atmospheric background field.

Speed of sound (in m/S).
